items.summary: Reject all three proposed implementation requests this cycle. They are technically reversible but not safely admissible: existing active/review/measurement work, unavailable operations and fleet-doctor evidence, incomplete AI-cost coverage, low or zero-volume baselines, and unresolved financial attribution prevent defensible release and outcome measurement. Retain the implementation, security, release, and financial-claim gates. Do not request duplicate telemetry or create new production work. Preserve the revenue intent and revisit the highest-value candidate only after canonical capacity, baseline, threshold, tests, attribution boundary, rollback, and release evidence are recorded.
